8:41 AM. You said:

Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?

08:41 AM

Yes, just a few basics 😊

For a beginner, the main things to think about are:
• where it will be fitted
• whether your wall is brick, concrete, stone, or render
• whether you want to install it yourself or use professional installation
• a secure code you can remember

If you install it yourself, you will usually need a power drill, a pen or pencil, measuring equipment, and for police preferred models the correct drill bit and Torx driver. The fixings are inside the key safe, and you should use the supplied security screws and fit it flush to the wall, directly into brick or concrete, not mortar, and at least 15 cm from a corner.

You also do not necessarily need to buy a fitting pack. If you already have the right tools, you do not need one. If you are using professional installation, you do not need a fitting pack at all.

If you prefer not to do it yourself, professional installation is available here: https://keysafe.co.uk/pages/professional-installation

8:42 AM. You said:

How do I use it properly the very first time?

08:42 AM

Absolutely, it can feel a bit unfamiliar the first time 😊

For the C500 Pro, the basic first-time use is:
• pull open the weather cover
• press the CLEAR button
• enter your code, pressing each button firmly until it clicks
• turn the OPEN dial clockwise 180° to open
• to lock it again, close the lid and turn the OPEN dial counter-clockwise 180° back to the locked position

A couple of important first-time tips:
• choose a code that is ideally 5 to 7 digits
• each number can only be used once
• make a note of your code and keep it somewhere safe, because there is no override or reset code
• if you press a wrong button, press CLEAR and enter the code again

There is also a quick guide here: https://attachments.gorgias.help/RdOkb7oZrBP2VXGN/hc/1QNmd2YYkd29XA0W/2026031911-69c8e32c-4cf9-4e68-be9b-84cc95168c4e-how%20to%20operate%20c500%20pro%20key%20safe.pdf
